propositions: A new advisory AGENT-tier CONTAINER plan-review criterion (decomp-shape) detects two decomposition-shape smells: layer-cake partitioning (children split by architectural layer) and consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge (child consumes sibling output without explicit ordering edge).
The criterion registers in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED), adds to pass1.CONTAINER_CRITERIA, and routes with advisory posture and container facet via criteria_routing.json.
The eval_solver container-arm extends to run container criteria over fixtures with children: lists via pass1_container, enabling bounded sanity calibration without batch-eval corpus.

Bounded sanity testing confirms the criterion fires on layer-cake and consumed-artifact positives (recall 1.0) and does not fire on vertical-slice and ordered producer/consumer negatives (false-accept 0.0).

Advisory->blocking promotion is gated on dogfood effectiveness metrics AND E6's order-stability improvement (fleiss_kappa > 0.6 floor), which currently fails at 0.55; blocking-promotion is deferred until both gates clear.
The change is registered in the effectiveness recorder auto-wiring and documented in plan-review-gate.md with promotion-gate protocol and E6 order-sensitivity prerequisite.
